messages.author: 6e1d90cc1d3ae466
messages.subject: histogram problem
parts:
Hi,

I would like to plot histograms of different variables like this
example from the mpg dataset below, only I would like to multiply the
counts of each variable (manufacturer in this case) - by a different
factor. I would really appreciate some help!

ggplot(mpg, aes(x=cty)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1) +
facet_grid(manufacturer ~ .)

Thanks,
Atanas

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: histogram problem
parts:
How about doing this then:

mults <- c( "audi"=5, "chevrolet"=20, "dodge"=34 ) # etc.
mpg$cty2 <- mults[ mpg$manufacturer ] * mpg$cty

...and then build your plot using the new cty2 variable?

Ben
